script: await page.goto('https://adactinhotelapp.com/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' }); addLog('Navigated to Adactin Hotel Portal'); await screenshot('01-initial-state'); await page.fill('#username', 'adactin_demo_user'); await page.fill('#password', 'demo_password'); await page.click('#login'); addLog('Credentials submitted'); await page.waitForSelector('#location', { state: 'attached', timeout: 5000 }); await screenshot('02-login-success'); await page.selectOption('#location', 'Sydney'); addLog('Selected Sydney location'); await page.click('#Submit'); addLog('Search submitted'); await page.waitForSelector('#radiobutton_0', { state: 'attached', timeout: 5000 }); await screenshot('03-search-results'); addLog('All steps completed');
